blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Travelers should brace for another round of steep airfare increases as airlines raise fuel surcharges to their highest level since May. In an advisory on Monday, the Civil Aeronautics Board (CAB) announced it will implement a Level 17 fuel surcharge from Oct. 1 to 15, three notches higher than the Level 14 imposed in the second half of September. READ: Airfares to rise anew as fuel surcharge hits Level 14 At Level 17, airlines may collect between P559 and P1,635 per passenger for domestic flights and between P1,846.10 and P13,726.58 for international flights.
